limitations: Use the complete native passenger-car service per positive vehicle-kilometre through the shared regionalization, IAM efficiency, energy floor, fuel-carbon and fleet-market methods. Retain vehicle production, maintenance, wear, road, disposal and all ancillary burdens once; no occupancy, payload, lifetime or production multiplier is added.

These 2021-labelled native services are historical prototypes; some electric/fuel-cell documentation states a 2020 technology basis. Preserve their source design and the shared relative IAM calculation, warning about class, geography, driving cycle, fleet, vintage, allocation, internal uncertainty and native biosphere exclusions. Score effects are unquantified.

Legacy complete native vehicles have no declared capacity-market sizing contract. Retain their installed kg-based pack and vehicle-mass model under the existing shared legacy-inventory policy; do not fabricate a kWh-capacity purchase or constant-range contract from rounded specifications. The separate marked CLIC vehicles retain their own existing sizing policy.

Use the complete native Compact class as the representative of this IAM role, without a mass or class-conversion factor. Native Compact is an explicit screening proxy for the REMIND Subcompact Car category; body size, mass and capacity may differ and are not corrected by an invented factor.
